title: Emergency Fire Drill Map & Extinguisher Rules
problem: Hostel students panic when smoke comes out of electrical main boards, because no one has seen how to operate the red fire extinguishers.
idea: Simple fire safety posters for every corridor. They show the exit way, the R.A.C.E. rule and the P.A.S.S. steps to use an extinguisher. Learn the steps and test yourself in the quiz.

widgets.heading: 🧯 P.A.S.S. — How to use a fire extinguisher
widgets.intro: Only for small fires, and only if a teacher or grown-up says it is safe. Stand about 2 metres away with your back to the exit.

items.title: P — Pull
items.text: Pull out the safety pin at the top.
items.te: పై భాగంలో ఉన్న సేఫ్టీ పిన్‌ను లాగండి.

items.title: A — Aim
items.text: Aim the nozzle at the BASE (bottom) of the fire, not at the flames.
items.te: నాజిల్‌ను మంట కింది భాగం వైపు గురిపెట్టండి.

items.title: S — Sweep
items.text: Sweep from side to side until the fire is out.
items.te: మంట ఆరిపోయే వరకు పక్క నుండి పక్కకు ఊపండి.

items.title: R — Rescue
items.text: Help people near the fire to get out.

items.title: A — Alarm
items.text: Shout 'Fire!', ring the bell and call 101 (Fire service).
items.te: 'మంట!' అని అరవండి, గంట కొట్టండి, 101కి ఫోన్ చేయండి.

items.title: C — Contain
items.text: Close doors behind you to stop smoke spreading.

items.title: E — Extinguish or Evacuate
items.text: Use the extinguisher only on a small fire. If it is big, leave by the exit route.
items.te: చిన్న మంటకే ఎక్స్‌టింగ్విషర్. పెద్దదైతే బయటకు వెళ్ళిపోండి.

questions.q: Smoke is coming from the electrical main board. What do you do first?
options: Tell a teacher to switch off the main power and call for help
questions.why: Never pour water on electrical fires. Switch off power (only an adult) and raise the alarm.

questions.q: Which number do you call for the Fire service in India?
questions.why: 101 is Fire. 100 is Police, 108 is Ambulance. 112 also works for all emergencies.

questions.q: Where do you aim the extinguisher?
options: At the top of the flames
At the base of the fire
questions.why: Aim at the base (bottom), where the fire gets its fuel.

questions.q: There is thick smoke in the corridor. How should you move?
questions.why: Clean air stays near the floor. Crawl low and go to the exit.

questions.q: What does the first P in P.A.S.S. mean?
questions.why: Pull the safety pin first, then Aim, Squeeze, Sweep.

how: Walk each hostel floor with a teacher and draw a simple map: rooms, stairs, exits and where each extinguisher hangs.
Ask Gemini to explain R.A.C.E. and P.A.S.S. in very simple English and Telugu.
Open Canva, search 'safety poster' and pick a bright red-and-yellow template.
Add the floor map with green arrows to the exit, the P.A.S.S. steps and the number 101.
Print one poster for every corridor and stick it near the stairs and extinguisher.
Ask the warden to hold a fire drill so everyone practises walking out calmly.
prompt: I am a Class 8 hostel student. Explain the R.A.C.E. fire rule and the P.A.S.S. steps for using a fire extinguisher in very simple English and Telugu, in short lines that fit on a poster. Add what to do if smoke comes from an electrical board.
